international.title: Senators castigate Apple and Google for letting teens access ‘nudify’ apps despite parental controls
international.summary: Exclusive: three Senate Democrats sent letters to tech CEOs saying safeguards against nudification apps are insufficient on their platforms A trio of US Senators say Apple and Google are failing to effectively detect and remove apps that can be used to generate nonconsensual nude or pornographic imagery. They also say Meta is continuing to profit off of ads for these so-called nudification apps that “victimize women and girls worldwide”. On Wednesday, senators Ron Wyden, Ed Markey and Ben Luján sent letters to the CEOs of the tech companies, saying the safeguards they have in place to keep nudification off their app stores or platforms are not sufficient.
